mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1400K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1400K units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of economic conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 3.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200K in a month, the combined signal of a tight labor market predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and stock performance
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances compared to non-triggered periods over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average, signaling supply chain resilience, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward IC of this mechanism with SPX returns is below 0.01 over any 18-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2%, indicating sluggish demand, predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP growth and stock market correlation
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth is below 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 50 basis points in a quarter and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is above its 12-month average, the combined signal of tightening monetary policy and rising inflation predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increase > 50bps in a quarter and CPIAUCSL > 12-month MA
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower (t-test p > 0.05) in triggered instances compared to non-triggered periods over a 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in two consecutive months, signaling labor market stress, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market shocks and stock reactions
failure_condition: Walk-forward IC of this mechanism with SPX returns is below -0.02 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail and food services sales (RSAFS) increasing by more than 5% in a month, indicating strong consumer spending, always predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of other economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of instances when RSAFS growth exceeds 5%.
